country.name: Tanzania

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by TanzLII's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect (or the date a Revised Edition is as at) as Laws.Africa records it. No date is computed from a default rule.

sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act in this part, /akn/tz/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date> (ordinances /akn/tz/act/ord/...). Each version's source_url is the expression it was parsed from, and its sha256 is that of the page.

decisions: Part 60-batch2: acts chosen for their weight in everyday practice (evidence, contract, interpretation, land, land registration, succession, legal aid, public audit, prosecutions, ward tribunals) among the TanzLII acts whose current expression could be read with its text. An act whose newest page lists an amendment TanzLII has not yet applied was left out (for example the Criminal Procedure Act, the Magistrates' Courts Act and the Value Added Tax Act), because its last version would not be today's law; so were the Arbitration Act, 2020 and the Access to Information Act, 2016, whose History names the 2023 Revised Edition (31 December 2023) without a TanzLII version of it.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the Tanzania configuration and scripts and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py, constitution.py and the shared peachjam.py are deterministic code.
